comments.text: Bug: in the Create error path, recordLegacyDuration is called on a storage failure; it should be recordStorageDuration. Suggested change to that call.
Inconsistency: the success-path metrics call passes name instead of options.Kind, unlike the other methods. Suggests using options.Kind.
Bug: in the Update error path, recordLegacyDuration is called on a storage failure; it should be recordStorageDuration. Suggested change to that call.
Context issue: in Delete, klog.NewContext is given d.Log rather than the enriched log variable, which breaks logging consistency. Suggests passing log instead.
Bug: in the legacy DeleteCollection goroutine, recordStorageDuration is used; it should be recordLegacyDuration. Suggested change to that call.
Logic: the variable p is undefined in the NewDualWriter call. Suggests declaring p := prometheus.NewRegistry() or moving it to shared test setup.
Logic: the mock types legacyStoreMock and storageMock are used but not defined or imported in the file.
Logic: the type updatedObjInfoObj is undefined; it should be defined or replaced with an existing mock.
Logic: the error test case sets up the legacy Create mock but omits the setupStorageFn call, so unified storage is not mocked.
